limitations: Regional bounding-box snapshot, not a complete or live bank directory. Major Canadian banks and documented local credit-union brands only; other providers may be outside this allowlist.
Standalone ATMs and non-branch financial businesses are excluded; branches with an on-site ATM are retained once. Staffed advice-only locations can be included; cash services are not guaranteed.

Operator locator review confirms source definitions and selected disputed records, not the current status of every mapped branch. Unreported relocations, closures, missing branches and stale service-brand names can remain.
Different service brands are retained through mergers unless a location-specific correction is documented. Ownership changes alone do not create or remove physical branches.
Coordinates are community map points or footprint centres, not verified entrances. Missing city/address tags are not inferred. Metro Vancouver region is a bbox, not a municipal boundary.
Duplicates are merged only with compatible brand/address/references or node containment. Different branch references, units and street addresses are protected; proximity alone is insufficient.
refresh_policy: One bounded POST, no automatic retries or visitor-time calls. Validate before replacing outputs; errors, partial results, missing major banks and material drops preserve the previous snapshot.
